title: SharePoint Isn't Boring Anymore: How Copilot Is Reinventing the Modern Workplace with Marcin Siewnicki [MVP]
description:
SharePoint has long been seen as complicated and boring, but Copilot turns it into the knowledge layer of the modern workplace. In this conversation, MVP Marcin Siewnicki shares practical advice for IT pros, intranet owners and governance teams on information architecture, sprawl, metadata and permissions. You will learn what to fix before AI arrives and how Copilot, agents and Power Automate fit together.
In this episode
00:00 – Intro and Marcin's SharePoint journey05:45 – Why SharePoint got a bad reputation17:20 – Sprawl, Teams and SharePoint27:47 – Governance policies for SharePoint and Teams33:38 – Document management and metadata41:09 – What Copilot changes in SharePoint47:46 – SharePoint agents and Power Automate54:35 – Rapid fire round
Key takeaways
SharePoint's bad reputation stems mostly from missing information architecture and IT-driven intranets rather than from the platform itself.Simple governance such as site request forms with business justification, periodic usage and permission reviews, and controlled versioning keeps SharePoint and Teams manageable.Copilot makes SharePoint the main knowledge source of the organization, so basic metadata and well-governed content directly improve AI answers, while Power Automate remains the choice for deterministic processes.
Worth quoting
“So usually SharePoint is a shared folder for huge bucket for everything. So there's no information architecture. And then it's hard to find information, hard to find documents.” – Marcin Siewnicki (08:17)
“I always encourage people to build or implement even basic metadata, policy metadata model, because it will help them later, and metadata are supported by copilot” – Marcin Siewnicki (38:26)
